so much dysfunction comes from all the theatrics to "measure velocity"

forget about it

not worth it

...it is so surreal to think that something so artificial and weird has come this far.

It is not real.

None of these #s are real.

We want to add less complexity to our products not more.

We want to achieve more with less work.

it is like a medieval medical treatment that never worked .... but that people just kept around  just because.

and then people believe it is a thing.

It isn't! It is like removing eyeballs with chopsticks.

I mean bless this person's soul...they are under the spell of a completely imaginary cult

we need to extract them, asap.
